_comment: Candidate monsters DESIGNED BY THE MONSTERS AGENT, not yet in the game. Each is generated on PixelLab as an 8-direction base (create-character-v3, from scratch, zero animations) and tagged MONSTER_CANDIDATE — never MONSTER, which is the shipping roster's ground truth. The maintainer reviews the 8 directions in the wiki; an APPROVED candidate is retagged MONSTER and only then gets its five animated states. `size` stays <= 176: measured over the 57 shipped monsters plus the maintainer's two references, 1 px/px density holds through 184 and degrades from ~236 (storm_shellback at 256 is the reference 'zoomed' case). Prompts are high-detail on purpose (maintainer 2026-09-09: low detail confuses the model — it cannot tell what is what). Prompts never name a facing or a background: v3 rotates a south sprite and always renders transparent.

candidates.name: Lanternwing
candidates.prompt: Plump fantasy cave bat with soft charcoal-gray fur, oversized rounded ears with glowing amber inner membranes, large dark shiny eyes, two tiny white fangs, wide leathery wings with visible finger bones and slightly torn edges, and a small glowing amber lantern-like tuft on each wingtip.
candidates.lore: It roosts where the miners' lamps went out. The twin glows on its wings are the only light left down there, and it knows it.

candidates.name: Plumefist
candidates.prompt: Stocky flightless fantasy bird with a barrel chest, thick scaly yellow legs ending in hooked black talons, a heavy hooked beak, a tall crest of stiff feathers in teal, crimson and gold, barred brown-and-cream wing feathers, and a long fan of iridescent rainbow tail plumes.
candidates.lore: Too heavy to fly and too proud to care. It settles every argument with its legs, and it starts most of them.

candidates.name: Snapshell
candidates.prompt: Large fantasy shore crab with a barnacle-crusted orange-red shell, one enormous curved pincer with a pale bone-white edge and a smaller pincer, six jointed legs with dark tips, stalked black eyes, and clumps of green seaweed and small sea shells stuck to its back.
candidates.lore: The tide brings it up and forgets to take it back. It holds the beach with one great claw and never learned to let go.

candidates.name: Clankball
candidates.prompt: Round fantasy armored pill bug with a compact ball-shaped body of overlapping dark iron-gray plates riveted with copper studs, short stubby legs tucked beneath it, two glowing orange slit eyes at the front, small antennae, and hot orange light glowing between the plates.
candidates.lore: It rolls downhill at anything that moves and uphill at anything that doesn't. The smiths say the plates ring in a key they can't forge.

candidates.name: Reedling
candidates.prompt: Chubby fantasy dragonfly nymph with a short segmented mossy-green body like a bundled reed, six short stubby legs, two large round glassy green eyes, small folded wing buds on its back, a hinged jaw mask over its face, and droplets of water beading on its shell.
candidates.lore: Not yet the thing with wings. It waits in the reeds with its jaw folded, and unfolds it faster than anything that wades.

candidates.name: Silkmaw
candidates.prompt: Huge fantasy cave spider with a hairy black abdomen marked with a pale bone-white skull pattern, eight long jointed legs with dark red joints, a cluster of eight glowing red eyes, large dripping fangs, and thick strands of white silk trailing from its spinnerets.
candidates.lore: It spins in the dark and waits for the dark to be crossed. The skull on its back is the last thing many travellers read.

candidates.name: Nacrebite
candidates.prompt: Fantasy giant clam monster with a ridged blue-gray shell edged in shimmering mother-of-pearl, the shell gaping open to show a soft pink fleshy mouth with rows of small teeth and one large glowing pearl inside, walking on six pale hermit-crab legs with a fringe of short blue tentacles.
candidates.lore: It grows one pearl a century and guards it with the whole of its shell. Divers who reach for it come up in pieces.

candidates.name: Twineback
candidates.prompt: Hunched fantasy forager bandit wearing a ragged moss-green hooded cloak over patched brown leather, face hidden in shadow except a crooked nose and two glinting eyes, a rusty sickle in one hand, twine-tied bundles of herbs, roots and dried grass strapped across the back, and muddy bare feet.
candidates.lore: Not a monster, exactly. A man who took to the hedgerows and now takes from everyone who walks them.

candidates.name: Pyrelord
candidates.prompt: Hulking fantasy fire demon lord shown full body from horns to feet, standing on thick clawed legs, with a body of black volcanic rock split by glowing orange magma cracks, a crown of jagged obsidian horns wreathed in flames, burning white-hot eyes, massive clawed hands, a molten glowing chain draped across its chest, and flames rising from its shoulders.
candidates.lore: The mountain's first king, and its only one. Every eruption since has been him clearing his throat.

candidates.name: Mistling
candidates.prompt: Small cute fantasy mist spirit shaped like a floating puff of pale blue-white fog with a round soft body, wide sleepy glowing white eyes, two tiny wispy arms, faint curling swirls trailing off its edges, and a small glowing blue droplet floating just above its head.
candidates.lore: Morning fog that forgot to lift. It drifts after travellers, dampening lanterns and whispering half a word.

candidates.name: Rimehulk
candidates.prompt: Hulking fantasy yeti with thick shaggy white fur crusted with ice, long powerful arms ending in blue-black claws, a broad ape-like face with a wide mouth of jagged icicle teeth, glowing pale blue eyes, icicles hanging from its chin and elbows, and a frost-blue underbelly.
candidates.lore: The blizzard walks on two legs up there. Climbers hear it breathing through the snow long before the snow turns red.

candidates.name: Gildmaw
candidates.prompt: Fantasy treasure chest mimic with a dark oak wooden body bound in tarnished brass bands, the lid gaping open as a huge mouth with gold coins for teeth and a long purple tongue, two glowing greedy yellow eyes on the lid, gold coins and gems spilling out, standing on four short clawed wooden legs.
candidates.lore: It ate a king's ransom and then the king. Everything it has ever swallowed still glitters between its teeth.

candidates.name: Bulbling
candidates.prompt: Small cute round fantasy seed creature with a smooth tan bulb body, a single green sprout with two soft leaves growing from the top of its head, large friendly black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, two tiny stubby legs and a short curling root tail.
candidates.lore: Planted by nobody and growing anyway. It hops after anything warm and is heartbroken to be stepped on.

candidates.name: Puffowl
candidates.prompt: Small cute round fantasy owl chick covered in extremely fluffy cream and brown feathers, enormous golden eyes, a tiny orange beak, short stubby wings with barred brown feather tips, and small clawed orange feet.
candidates.lore: All eyes and no patience. It falls out of every nest it is put in and pecks whoever picks it up.

candidates.name: Boglurk
candidates.prompt: Fantasy amphibian monster like a giant axolotl with slimy dark olive skin, feathery crimson external gills fanning from its head, a wide flat toothy grin, bulging yellow eyes, four webbed clawed limbs, a short tail curled tightly under its round body, and strands of slime and pond weed hanging from its body.
candidates.lore: Only the gills show above the mud, red as flowers. Pick one and the rest of it comes up smiling.

candidates.name: Hollowplate
candidates.prompt: Fantasy hollow suit of rusted plate armor animated by green witchfire, nothing inside it, green flames burning in the empty helmet visor, a chipped greatsword held in one gauntlet, a torn dark cape, and cracks in the armor leaking green light.
candidates.lore: The knight left long ago. The armor kept the vigil, and the fire that keeps it standing has forgotten whose it was.

candidates.name: Veilmother
candidates.prompt: Tall floating fantasy wraith with a gaunt pale face, hollow black eyes weeping dark tears, a long tattered veil and dress of gray-white cloth fading into mist at the bottom, long thin arms with elongated fingers, and a faint cold blue glow around its body.
candidates.lore: She searches every cradle in the valley and finds none of them hers. The cold that follows her is the closest she gets to company.

candidates.name: Gloomcap
candidates.prompt: Fantasy walking mushroom creature with a wide dark purple cap spotted with pale glowing dots, a pale stubby stalk body, two small glowing lavender eyes, stubby arms and legs, and puffs of purple spores venting from the gills under the cap.
candidates.lore: It walks when the woods are dark and stands very still when they are not. The spores smell sweet, which is how it wins.

candidates.name: Stormroc
candidates.prompt: Enormous fantasy storm bird with dark slate-blue feathers edged in white lightning, a hooked steel-gray beak, blazing white eyes, wings raised high above its back crackling with electric arcs, no feathers hanging below its talons, long sharp talons, and a crest of feathers standing up like jagged lightning bolts.
candidates.lore: It nests above the weather and hunts below it. Every thunderclap on the fells is a wingbeat somebody did not see.

candidates.name: Cinderimp
candidates.prompt: Small mischievous fantasy imp with dark red skin, two small curved black horns, a wide grin of sharp white teeth, glowing orange eyes, small bat-like wings, a pointed tail with a flame at the tip, and a tiny rusty pitchfork held in both hands.
candidates.lore: The smallest thing the volcano ever coughed up, and the loudest. It steals boots and sets them on fire out of principle.

retired.name: Twigwhirr
retired.prompt: Fantasy dragonfly whose long body is a living twig with bark texture and tiny green leaves sprouting from it, four short rounded translucent wings held close to its body with visible veining and a rainbow sheen, big compound eyes like green glass beads, and small leaf-shaped legs.
retired.lore: A twig that learned to fly by watching the reeds. It hums over still water and bites whatever ripples it.
retired.retired: a dragonfly's wingspan fights a square canvas: v1 (80px, long wings) clipped 3 facings, v2 (96px, short wings) clipped 7 — the model draws the span to the canvas whatever the prompt says. Replaced by reed_nymph, the compact larval form.

retired.name: Ironclack
retired.prompt: Heavily armored fantasy beetle with overlapping dark iron-gray plates riveted with copper studs, a single short thick horn on its head, six thick segmented legs tucked close under its body, glowing orange slits for eyes, and cracks between the plates showing hot orange light underneath.
retired.lore: Forged, or grown — the smiths cannot agree. Its plates ring like a bell when struck, and the sound calls the others.
retired.retired: a horned beetle's side profile outgrows a square canvas: v1 88px (legs), v2 96px legs tucked (curved horn), v3 104px short horn (E/W body) — three rolls, three edge clips. Replaced by shell_roller, a compact curled pill bug in the same armored-insect niche.
